recommendation.mechanism: The article keeps generated dataset profiles separate from owner reviewed global, team and analysis guidance, binds both to an asset identity and regenerates summary indexes from changed leaves upward. Navigation selects a relevant document before fetching its full context. Dataset grain, required filters, valid joins and time dependent exceptions determine answer meaning even when SQL executes successfully. These are candidate additions to analytical read model or agent retrieval guidance, with curated corrections surviving regeneration.
recommendation.proposed_check: Proposed, unexecuted: two similarly named datasets have different grain and one has an owner correction to a generated join rule. Regenerate the profile without losing that correction, fetch the complete relevant guidance and reject a plausible answer that double counts rows.
